text:
Maya Rao: Heads-up — Delfin Analytics sent back the SOW asking for 48% off the first quarter, removal of the $10k pilot minimum, and Net45 billing. Need deal desk sign-off.

Ben Ortiz: Account owned by Ben (AE). Pilot 3mo, est 55M tokens/mo (embeddings + gen). They said committed Dedicated could follow if latency checks out.

Connor Wu: Finance note: 48% is above our typical pilot cap (45%). Removing the minimum changes our billing protection. Any PO or credit instrument?

Maya Rao: No PO yet. Customer wants consolidated monthly billing and Net45 due to internal procurement cycles. They specifically asked we drop the $10k min to keep pilot lightweight.

Leah Summers: RevenueOps: Removing the floor will change our minimum-recognized revenue profile and complicate rev rec. Suggest keeping a nominal floor ($2k) or invoice at list and apply a one-time contra onboarding credit to simulate waiver.

Connor Wu: Finance counter proposal for deal desk:

```
Item: Pilot (55M tokens/mo) - list $5,500/mo
Requested: 48% off months 1-3, remove $10k min, Net45
Finance counter: 40% off months 1-3 + option A: keep $2k pilot min OR option B: set min $0 with $6k one-time onboarding credit (contra-revenue). Billing Net30. If customer insists on Net45, require PO + credit holdback or VP-Finance approval.
```

approvals-bot: Approval ticket APP-5407 created -> assigned to Connor Wu + VP-Finance. Summary: Delfin Analytics pilot pricing/term exception (48% off + min removal + Net45). Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-5407 :white_check_mark:

Ben Ortiz: Sales can accept finance counter (40% + $6k credit) to keep deal moving. I'll request PO and push for Net30.

Maya Rao: Thanks — I'll update the SOW to reflect finance counter and mark signature pending APP-5407. Holding execution until approval resolved.
